title: World BEYOND War Stop ReArm Europe coalition expansion
summary: Expanded the exhausted current WBW Europe chapter list one direct coalition edge outward into Stop ReArm Europe, its current coordination members TNI, WILPF and IPB, and three public leadership people.

provenance.method: bounded current first-party coalition expansion with repository deduplication

classification_rules: Treat Stop ReArm Europe initiator/coordination-member listings as explicit current organization-to-campaign relationships.
Treat public leadership titles only as source-bounded organizational roles; do not infer additional affiliations.
data.method: Follow the current World BEYOND War Europe campaign edge to Stop ReArm Europe, dedupe coalition nodes against the corpus, then cross-enumerate current public leadership from first-party pages.
data.narrative_role: bounded chapter/affiliate and public-person expansion investigator
data.research_question: Which direct current coalition and public-person edges can be materialized one hop outward from the resolved WBW Europe graph?

findings.finding: World BEYOND War's current Europe page identifies Stop ReArm Europe as a campaign WBW participates in.
Stop ReArm Europe's current campaign page lists World BEYOND War, TNI, WILPF and IPB among initiators and coordination members.
Current first-party pages identify Fiona Dove at TNI, Amrita Kapur at WILPF, and Alain Rouy at IPB in public leadership roles.
